metric: Pairs decided from SQL and column names alone: 752 proved equivalent, 1874 proved different by a counterexample database, 174 unknown. All 2,800 pairs are also in VeriEQL's LeetCode set, which keeps the keys these files drop.
caveats: Rewrite rules were written while looking at these pairs; the held-out fifth was reserved partway through, so it is a weak check. The published labels assume LeetCode's keys and NOT NULL rules, which the files omit, so 476 pairs labelled equivalent get a valid counterexample here. Data is downloaded from a pinned commit (no licence file, not bundled). The October counterexample-search changes (seed per pair, duplicate rows, three-decimal values, date and divisor neighbours) were developed on dev pairs only; the held-out fifth was not inspected. The outer-join flattening rules (outer_join_flatten.py) were developed on dev pairs only. Measured on master 9ba22c8, the merge of the outer-join flattening rules (#375).
correctness: 0 wrong: every proof re-checked on 900 random DuckDB databases; every 'different' carries a database on which DuckDB returns different bags (numbers compared as rounded floats, fractions exact in binary)
held_out: 539/580, 0 wrong (held-out fifth, by hash of the pair)
